capabilities.name: RTK
capabilities.purpose: Compress routine shell output before it enters context
capabilities.source_identity: spec=github:rtk-ai/rtk (repo EXISTS, git-only, not on npm/PyPI)
capabilities.selected_version: UNPINNED (upstream has no published stable registry release)
capabilities.package: NOT the npm 'rtk' (=cliffano/rtk changelog tool, UNRELATED — rejected)
capabilities.integration: intended: Claude Code Bash PreToolUse hook
capabilities.update: per upstream once a vetted release exists
capabilities.limitations: No registry-published, publisher-verifiable, pinnable release found. Per source-verification policy #18 not installed. Workflow degrades gracefully: COMPRESSION.md routing applies; without RTK use raw output + manual summarization.

capabilities.name: Headroom
capabilities.purpose: Compress large non-shell context with reversible retrieval (MCP)
capabilities.package: NOT pypi 'headroom' (=SUNKENDREAMS/headroom CLI AI assistant, UNRELATED — rejected)
capabilities.update: per upstream once a vetted release exists
capabilities.uninstall: uv tool uninstall <pkg> ; claude mcp remove headroom
capabilities.limitations: Do NOT use headroom wrap/proxy or ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL. No vetted registry release. Not installed. COMPRESSION.md boundary still governs manual behavior.

capabilities.name: Playwright/Chromium
